summary: The City of Toronto did provide garbage pick-up service at the strip mall located at 1819-1889 Lawrence Avenue East. The City stopped providing garbage pick-up at this strip plaza over 10 years ago. As a result, piles of garbage bags and illegal waste material are ‎left on the boulevard causing unsightly conditions.
decided: City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards, in cooperation with the General Manager, Solid Waste Management Services, to inspect 1819 - 1889 Lawrence Avenue East with respect to compliance with all waste management related property standards and take any necessary action as deemed appropriate to improve the cleanliness of the subject property and surrounding area.
